daily.today_energy: Mercury's got your back today, Sag. You're in that sweet spot where curiosity and confidence collide—use it to explore something you've been putting off. The vibe is playful but purposeful.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your person needs to hear from you today. Not anything heavy—just genuine. Single? Someone's been watching from the sidelines. Pay attention to who shows up when you're just being yourself.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. This is the energy to pitch, propose, or start that project you've been workshopping in your head. Don't wait for permission; the momentum is yours.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement today—doesn't have to be intense, just something that makes you feel alive. Whether that's a walk, dancing in your room, or stretching, honor what feels good.

weekly.overview: Your cosmic energy is shifting toward authenticity this week. Venus is nudging you to drop the mask and show up as your real self. Something that felt stuck is finally starting to move—trust the momentum, babe.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is your moment to have that real conversation you've been avoiding. Single? Someone intriguing is about to enter your orbit. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower rn.
